subject: Re: Quick follow-up — EoQ timing & priority check
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about Acme Cloud's plans for embedding LLM features into the admin console. Quick recap from our call:  

- Goals: reduce latency for in-app suggestions, achieve predictable per-token costs, and keep sensitive logs in your VPC.
- Recommended path: start with a Dedicated pool for the suggestions route, enable prefix KV caching for common prompts, and evaluate a 16-bit quantized variant for cost testing.
- Success metrics: 95th pct latency < 150ms and token cost <= $0.001/token for interactive workload.

Next steps we agreed on:
1) I’ll send a short pricing and deployment note (attached).
2) You’ll confirm legal/security stakeholders to engage for SOC 2 evidence and network peering.
3) Tentative demo of Dedicated capacity on 6/22 if that still works.

I attached a short pricing summary and the RFI I mentioned. If priorities or timing have shifted for EoQ planning, let me know — I'm happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0127

Attachments: redwood-pricing.pdf (PDF, 2 pages), AcmeCloud-RFI.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — demo & security contacts

Hi Sarah —

Dropping a quick note — wanted to see if 6/22 still works for the Dedicated demo and whether you had a chance to loop in your security team. If you prefer a later date we can move the demo — just want to align before month-end planning.

If helpful, Lauren can join the call to walk through the SOC 2 artifacts and peering checklist.

Would you be able to confirm:  
- Demo timing (6/22 or alternate)
- Primary security contact (name + email)
- Any budget/approval constraints we should know about for EoQ procurement?

Thanks — appreciate it,
Aditya

>

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmecloud.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: EoQ quick priority check — is this still moving?

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Hope you're having a good week. As we close the quarter I wanted to check in one last time on Acme Cloud's priority for this project. A few quick questions to help us plan capacity and a potential reserved commit proposal:

1) Has this moved up or down in priority for EoQ purchasing?
2) Is budget/approval on track for a decision in July (or do you expect a delay)?
3) Any outstanding blockers from legal/security we can help unblock (SOC 2 packet, peering checklist, IP/NDAs)?

If it's helpful, we can propose a flexible pilot commitment that preserves pricing while giving you more time to finalize approvals. No pressure — just want to make sure we're aligned and to free up our specialists if the timeline changes.

If I don't hear back, I'll assume timing has shifted and will follow up in mid-July.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
